# Tuki Tales

> Hindi Nursery Rhymes, Kids Poems & Cartoon Videos for children aged 1-6.

Tuki Tales is a Hindi-language YouTube channel producing musical, animated
nursery rhymes, kids poems, and cartoon videos for children aged 1-6.
New rhymes are uploaded every week. This is the official marketing site
for the channel — a lightweight, static HTML/CSS/JS site that pulls live
video data from YouTube without requiring any API key.

## Channel

- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Tuki-Tales
- Channel ID: UCn1SrgsVonl3OUb9m5oM_vw
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tukitales/
- YouTube Music: https://music.youtube.com/@Tuki-Tales
- (Placeholder, coming soon: Spotify, Apple Music, Facebook, X)

## Content Categories

- Hindi Nursery Rhymes (बालगीत)
- Hindi Poems for Kids (कविताएँ)
- Animated Cartoon Rhyme Videos
- Sing-Along Songs for Toddlers
- Lori & Lullabies
- Alphabet & Counting Rhymes
- Fun & Family-Friendly Content

## Site Sections (in order)

1. Hero — channel branding, subscribe CTA, channel stats
2. Featured — most popular video by lifetime views (live)
3. Popular Videos — grid of top 12 all-time popular videos (live)
4. Latest Videos — slider of 10 newest uploads (live via RSS)
5. Shorts — vertical 9:16 slider with hover-to-play (live)
6. Playlists — channel playlists, popular on top (live)
7. About — Hindi description of the channel
8. Join Family — final subscribe CTA
9. Footer — navigation, social links, copyright

## Tech Stack

- Pure static HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework
- Auto-deployed by Netlify from the GitHub `main` branch
- Live YouTube data fetched via `api.allorigins.win` CORS proxy
- Latest videos via YouTube RSS feed (no API key)
- Video titles via YouTube oEmbed API (CORS-enabled)
- Brand logo is a transparent PNG (500x500)
- Favicon is a 64x64 derivative of the brand logo

## Source Files

- `index.html` — main page
- `styles.css` — site styles
- `app.js` — JavaScript (live data fetching + UI rendering)
- `logo.png` — brand logo (transparent)
- `favicon.png` — site favicon
- `robots.txt` — crawler directives (includes AI/LLM allowlist)
- `sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap
- `site.webmanifest` — PWA manifest
- `netlify.toml` — Netlify build config + security headers
- `_redirects` — Netlify redirect rules

## Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/tukitales/tuki-tales
- Live: https://tukitales.netlify.app/

## Audience

Parents and caregivers of Hindi-speaking children aged 1-6, primarily in
India and the global Hindi diaspora. Content is family-friendly, educational,
and musical — designed to help children sing along, dance, and learn.
